visual_description: A collection of four essential field items: 1. High-impact polycarbonate safety glasses with 'Dust-Seal' foam edges. 2. Heavy-duty leather 'Palomino' work gloves (scuffed and stained with red dirt). 3. A pair of gel-filled tactical knee pads for 'Detail-Phase' crawling. 4. A wide-brimmed 'safari' style sun hat with a removable neck flap.

constraints.material: Distressed leather; breathable synthetic mesh; scratched clear plastic.
constraints.logic: Reduces 'Fatigue' and prevents 'Minor Injury' events during excavation.
